correctness.rationale: From the inspected RESULT.md and CHECK.py, H_{overline{z+t z^m}} has finite matrix E_00+tJ_m, with singular norm (1+sqrt(1+4t²))/2 for all m≥2. The exact Poisson-variance kernel profile is F=1−r²+t²(1−r^(2m))+2t(1−r²)r^(m−1) cos((m−1)theta). Subtracting F(0) and dividing by r² yields the quadratic −1+2t(1−r²)r^(m−3)−t²r^(2m−2). Rationalizing the smaller positive root gives t_-(r)=r^(3−m)/(1−r²+sqrt(1−2r²)). Its interior minimum for m≥4 is at sqrt(1−2r²)=2/(m−1), producing exactly T_m and the finite m−1 angular tie; m=3 instead attains the lower endpoint at r→0 and has unique radius sqrt((sqrt(1+6t)−2)/(3t)) for t>1/2. For m=2 strict concavity and implicit expansion give the claimed t⁴/2 small-amplitude gap. Rechecked numerically independently that T_m is reciprocal of an earlier C_{m,1} for m=3,4,5,8,10,18. The finite tests do not establish all m, which follows from the algebraic proof.
